data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 names a 'combinatorial diversity' integration but defines the covering principle as mere non-intersection of dependency sets. This collapses under the problem's own distinguishing criterion: nodes can have disjoint dependency sets yet still share a hidden common-cause trigger (e.g., a leap-second bug present independently in each node's own time library). The 'single shared substrate' refuter only catches common-dependency correlation, leaving apparent-independence-via-disjoint-dependencies unrefuted, so the integration does not actually distinguish independent from merely uncorrelated failure.
